ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image is a "United Kingdom topography" map. The United Kingdom is located on islands in western Europe, with latitude roughly between 50°N and 60°N, and longitude roughly between 10°W and around 0°. In the map, the United Kingdom is surrounded by sea areas, with oceans on the west, south, and north sides; in the legend there are "ocean current" arrows, and direction arrows of ocean currents are drawn in the sea areas around the United Kingdom on the map, indicating that the vicinity of the United Kingdom is obviously influenced by the ocean and ocean currents. The question stem asks "whether most rivers in the United Kingdom have an icing period". Combining that the United Kingdom is located in the western European region surrounded by ocean and is influenced by the North Atlantic Warm Current, the climate has temperate maritime characteristics, winters are relatively mild, and rivers generally do not easily freeze. Therefore, most rivers in the United Kingdom have no icing period.
